text.tspan: Human-centered research for the design and evaluation
of generative AI and computer vision systems.

g.text: June 4, 2026 · 8:30 AM-1:00 PM MDT · Room 710 · Denver, Colorado

text.tspan: HuG recenters attention on the people who use and are affected by
generative AI systems, bringing human-centric research into conversation
with technical design, evaluation, and deployment.

g.text: Senior Design Editor of AI Initiatives at The New York Times

text.tspan: Founder of Cita Press and contributor of humor and cartoons

g.text: Senior Research Scholar at Stanford HAI

text.tspan: Researches the societal and economic impact of AI and shapes
public policy on frontier AI systems.
